      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "returning false in production on oversized messages would stall the connection for minutes because SocketSendData makes no progress",
      "quote": "returning false would result in a stall of the connection for minutes (until it get disconnected for inactivity), since `SocketSendData` will never make progress",

      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "enforce application-level size limits at PushMessage rather than transport level",

      "status_by_id": "rc:3752690660",
